superseded.reason: Measured the wrong thing: (1) the TASK 3 bundled run had Stall Cycles = 0 (results/evidence/31_original_stalls.txt), so there was nothing to correlate against; (2) the substitute study used 16 hand-picked synthetic GEMMs on a 16x16 array and a binary agreement gate on a 5 % stall threshold, a metric that depends on the arbitrary threshold and class balance, and was not a real layer set. Replaced by rank correlations (threshold-free) on the real ResNet-18 layers. See COORDINATION.md Decisions P2-A1, P2-7.
